title: President Trump calls to delay nomination of intel pick Jay Clayton
summary: The Senate was set to begin the confirmation process for Jay Clayton as Director of National Intelligence Today. But President Trump is calling for a delay.
contentText:
Senators wanted to fast track President Trump's pick for Director of National Intelligence. But Trump now says he wants to delay until they pass voting legislation that already failed in the Senate.

(Image credit: Chip Somodevilla)
